quests.title: Goblins at the door
quests.ask: Goblins took a crate of rope off the Guild's road last night. The Guild pays its debts, {name}, and it collects them too. Ten of them should learn the price.
quests.thanks: Ten? That'll teach the rest. Pell the charcoal burner lives out in those woods. Go and see him. And the teachers here have work, if you want it.

quests.title: Ore for the forge

task.words: Gather 25 copper ore in Copper Hills

quests.ask: Garrow's forge eats copper faster than I dig it. Dig twenty-five ore in Copper Hills, {name}, and mind the loose rock.
quests.thanks: Twenty-five good lumps. Keep them. Garrow will show you what they're for.

quests.title: Wood for the fire

task.words: Gather 25 oak logs in Goblin Woods

quests.ask: Marta's fire is hungry, and so am I. Twenty-five oak logs from Goblin Woods. Watch for little green hands.
quests.thanks: Good wood. That'll keep the pot on till morning.

quests.title: Meat for the pot

task.words: Gather 12 venison on the deer trail

quests.ask: The camp eats too much bread. Twelve cuts of venison from the deer trail in Goblin Woods. Shoot clean.
quests.thanks: Clean cuts. Keep them for Marta. She'll know what to do.

quests.title: Perch at dawn
quests.ask: Perch bite all day at Mirror Lake, {name}. Fifteen of them, and keep your eyes on the water. Something big rolls out there.
quests.thanks: Fifteen perch, and you still have all your fingers. Good.

quests.title: Hides for the winter
quests.ask: Odda sent you? Then make yourself useful. My roof leaks, and my walls too. Fifteen goblin hides will patch them. The goblins won't need them.
quests.thanks: Hm. They stink, but they'll keep the rain out. Thank you, {name}.

quests.title: A blade of your own

task.words: Make a copper sword at the forge

quests.ask: Five copper ore makes a sword, {name}. Not a good one. Your own. Make it at my forge.
quests.thanks: Ugly. It'll cut. Now go and hit something with it.

quests.title: Something between you and the teeth
quests.ask: You go out there in your shirt? Four goblin hides make a vest. Make it, wear it, show me.
quests.thanks: Better. Now there's something between you and the teeth.

quests.title: Something hot

task.words: Cook 5 venison skewers at the camp fire

quests.ask: You've got venison? Then you can cook, {name}. Five skewers at my fire. A hero who can cook never goes hungry on the road.
quests.thanks: Not bad at all! Eat one before a hard fight. You'll feel it.

quests.title: The big brothers

task.words: Kill 20 goblin brutes in Goblin Woods

quests.ask: The small ones I can chase off with a stick. Not the big brothers. Twenty of them have been at my charcoal. Stop them.
quests.thanks: They came from the north, the brutes, same as the rest. Running. Go and tell Odda. She'll want to know.

quests.title: The old one

task.words: Kill the Old Bear in Goblin Woods

quests.ask: There's an old bear in the deep woods. Older than me. He kept to himself for years. Now the goblins push him out, and he's angry. Don't go unless you're ready.
quests.thanks: You beat the old one? Then the woods have a new old one, {name}.

quests.title: The dead walk
quests.ask: Goblins running south, and the dead walking in the Old Graveyard. It's the same trouble, {name}. I'd bet the ledger on it. Go and look. Aldous the sexton still lives out there.
quests.thanks: Skeletons in the old King's colours. I was afraid of that. Help Aldous. He won't ask, so I'm asking for him.

quests.title: Keep them down

task.words: Kill 40 skeletons in the Old Graveyard

quests.ask: They climb out every night, {name}. Forty of them back in the ground, and I might sleep a week. Might.
quests.thanks: Forty. They'll be back. They always come back while he's awake.

quests.title: Cloth for the graves
quests.ask: The zombies wear the old shrouds. I want them back, {name}. Fifteen pieces of grave cloth, to bind the graves shut. Don't ask me how I know that works.
quests.thanks: There. Bound. Now only one grave is still open, and it's the one with the crown.

quests.title: Bones for a shield

task.words: Make a bone shield at the forge

quests.ask: Copper's soft. Bone from the graveyard is harder, if you can stomach it. Five bones and two oak logs make a shield.
quests.thanks: Good. Don't think about whose they were.

quests.title: The King Who Would Not Rest
quests.ask: Aldous says the King wakes his guard every night. Put him back in the ground, {name}, and the road north opens. The Guild has waited a hundred years for that road.
quests.thanks: The King is down. Whatever comes next comes from the north. Rest tonight. Tomorrow the road is yours.

quests.title: Fish for a secret
quests.ask: You want a secret? Secrets cost. Fifteen sea bass off my rocks, friend, and I'll owe you one. A small one.
quests.thanks: Fair trade. Here's your secret: the crates I ship go north, to the Peak. Who pays for them? That one costs more.
